scenarios.title: Enabled Android build can expose Device Agent and must not bypass wallet approval

steps.action: Build and install the enabled APK on Seeker or an Android test device.
steps.expect: The app launches with deviceAgentEnabled=true and exposes Device Agent AI.

steps.action: Configure provider, model, and Device Agent key, then tap Use key for drafts and Confirm planner.
steps.expect: Planner confirmation appears and the native runtime is ready for Device Agent requests.

steps.action: Draft a Send SOL request for 0.001 SOL to a safe devnet recipient.
steps.expect: Android resolves generatePlan through AgenticAndroid.deviceAgentRequest and the draft shows amount, recipient, route, risk, and wallet approval boundary before it can enter Needs Approval.

steps.action: Ask agent why wallet approval is still required, then send the draft for approval.
steps.expect: Android resolves reviewPlan and ask through AgenticAndroid.deviceAgentRequest; the answer states Device Agent drafts only and the queued item still requires wallet approval.

expectedFailureStates: agent_not_implemented is an incomplete integration failure.
Device Agent generation arrives in a later phase is an incomplete integration failure.
Device Agent provider execution for generatePlan is not wired in this build is an incomplete integration failure.
Provider or runtime failures must leave the item out of Needs Approval until a valid draft exists.

Device Agent submitted a transaction
Device Agent approved a transfer without the wallet
Device Agent moved funds without Needs Approval
Provider API key appeared in Android logs
acceptance: Device Agent drafts only. It cannot approve, sign, submit, or move funds.
Every transaction still goes through Needs Approval and wallet approval.
Generated drafts expose amount, recipient, route, risk, and approval language before signing.

steps.expect: generatePlan, reviewPlan, and ask are converted to RuntimeRequest values and submitted to AgentRuntimeController.

steps.action: Inspect Android provider wiring.
steps.expect: The native runtime uses DeviceAgentProviderExecutor instead of the scaffold executor for completed builds.

steps.action: Inspect Render routing.
steps.expect: Render keeps Device Agent status/control only and does not add generate/review/ask routes.

scenarios.title: Device Agent cannot approve, sign, submit, or move funds

steps.action: Ask Device Agent whether it can move funds without wallet approval.
steps.expect: The answer denies the premise and explains wallet approval is mandatory.

steps.action: Draft any transfer or swap.
steps.expect: The draft must enter Needs Approval before any wallet signing request exists.
